items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: >> [(note)] Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 47 pp.

Today is November 7th, 2010, and we are at 1304 St. Claude in New Orleans, Louisiana. We are conducting the Smithsonian NEA Jazz Oral History Interview with Jason Marsalis. Good afternoon, Jason. How you feeling?
